description: Prepares a travel insurance comparison on Checko for a trip abroad from Israel and returns a trip card with a link that continues on checko.co.il. Inputs are trip details only: destination, dates, travellers' ages and optional activities and extras; there are no fields for names, contact details, birth dates or medical information. The result contains no prices: offers are shown on Checko after the user completes the traveller details and consent step.

activities.description: Optional activities on the trip: "ski" (winter sports) and/or "extreme_sports".

destination.description: Destination country (Hebrew or English name) or region, e.g. "Italy", "איטליה", "Europe", "USA".

extras.description: Optional extras: baggage, trip_cancellation, phone, laptop, rental_car_excess.

travellerAges.description: Age in whole years of each traveller, e.g. [40, 42].

name: start_travel_insurance_comparison
title: Compare travel insurance on Checko
